name: index-overnight-fractional
why: Five index-ETF agents are barren and the supplied momentum replays repeatedly fail. Test the distinct published overnight-drift hypothesis through a fixed late-session SPY entry and next-session morning exit, using fractional market orders capped at $2, fresh inputs, and a bounded spread filter. This is an untested execution variant of the existing equity-overnight hypothesis, not a new alpha claim or a reset of applicable lineage trials; normal replay, independent paper, audit, and capital gates remain mandatory.
